description: Use to start price alerts on an itinerary from a search, after the traveler confirms (asking for alerts is confirming). One way: any itinerary_id from search_flights. Round trip: an outbound itinerary_id from search_flights watches that outbound with its cheapest return; a complete itinerary_id from search_return_flights tracks that exact pairing. Multi-city: a complete itinerary_id. Alerts go to the account's channels on a new low; alert_rule any hears every move; target_price_usd sets a bar.

alert_rule.description: When to alert: lowest = only a new low, any = every price move, none = off. Leave empty for the default, or give target_price_usd instead.
alert_rule.title: Alert Rule

email.description: Send alerts by email. Empty keeps the account's setting.
email.title: Email

itinerary_id.description: From search_flights (one way) or search_return_flights (a complete round trip or multi-city).
itinerary_id.title: Itinerary Id

target_price_usd.description: Alert when the price goes under this, USD. Replaces alert_rule. It is the TOTAL: the whole trip for all travelers on a flight, the whole stay on a hotel.
target_price_usd.title: Target Price Usd

text.description: Send alerts by text message. Needs a verified phone on the SlickTrip account; empty keeps the account's setting.
text.title: Text

name: track_flight

alerts.description: Plain-words description of what alerts fire

alerts_when.description: When alerts fire, from the alert preference

channels.description: {email: boolean, text: boolean} stored alert channels

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: Note about text alerts needing a verified phone

outbound_fid.description: Outbound watch only: the outbound fid

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

route.description: Route dict: origin, destination, cabin, travelers, dates, trip_type (+names on outbound watch)

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

text_not_enabled.description: Text asked but no verified phone on account

watch.description: "outbound" when an outbound-only watch was saved

title: Track a flight's price
